sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Alok Singh,Maharaj Baksh Singh,Vijay Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Vijay Kumar, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Rakesh Kumar Singh, learned Addl.
Government Advocate, and perused the record.
2. By means of the instant application the applicant Suraj Mishra seeks bail in Case Crime No. 409 of 2022, under sections 120-B,420,467,468,471, I.P.C., P.S. Hazratganj, District Lucknow.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 22.11.2022 against one Priyanka Mishra alleging that she was taking interviews in the premises of the office of the Principal Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, Lucknow.
Upon making inquiries, nine candidates tried to run away.
Seven persons were apprehended and two persons escaped.
4. In the statement one Rahul Sharma, he stated that one of the named accused Priyanka Mishra had called him for verification of his documents and handing over joining letter to him.

He stated Suraj Mishra vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of ... on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76164118/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: that the applicant was calling persons in Room No. 329 and he was introducing them.
5. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail-application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent.
He has falsely been implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.

6. Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that one of the accused Shiv Sharan Srivastava, who is an official of Income Tax Department, has been granted bail by means of an order dated 31.05.2023 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 6214 of 2023.
7.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 6214 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant is not an employee of the Income Tax Department and he has been implicated in the case merely on the basis of statement of a person that he was calling persons inside the room,
and that official of the Income Tax Department has already been granted bail and the applicant is languishing in jail since 02.12.2022, without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail.
8. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
(Subhash Vidyarthi, J.) Order Date :- 21.7.2023
